row.body: Personal note: the insecticide crew crossed at dawn, leaving yellow dust on the grass. The deer fled before the county trucks reached the trail.
row.title: torn note from the north trail

sidecar.gloss: A personal trace links farm-program residue to symptoms before a restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while crossing treated land; the personal trace does not by itself prove the farm program caused the emergency.
